supplies.name: Seed Packet
supplies.description: Heal 6 Cohesion.
supplies.visualBrief: A tiny foil seed packet with torn corners, bright safflower seeds spilling out, taped to a mini courier strap; bold streetwear colors, crisp object silhouette, rooftop-market grit, matching the Bird Squad title splash art.

supplies.name: Signal Flare
supplies.description: Gain 2 Resonance. Draw 1.
supplies.visualBrief: A stubby red-orange rooftop flare with a taped pull-ring, sparking cyan and amber smoke in a controlled plume; high-contrast neon against dark metal, utilitarian bird-scale gear, title-splash street fantasy style.

supplies.name: Zip Tie Roll
supplies.description: Gain 10 Cover.
supplies.visualBrief: A coiled roll of black and teal zip ties clipped to a scratched bottlecap spool, with a few ties bent into quick brace shapes; clean readable silhouette, practical urban salvage, Bird Squad splash-art lighting.

supplies.name: Bottlecap Popper
supplies.description: Deal 6 damage that ignores Cover.
supplies.visualBrief: A spring-loaded bottlecap launcher built from a pen spring, brass cap, and red thread trigger, sized for a bird talon; energetic comic-book silhouette, tiny hazard stripes, bright metal glints, title-splash rooftop grit.

supplies.name: Tar Solvent
supplies.description: Remove up to 10 Cover from the selected enemy.
supplies.visualBrief: A thumb-sized glass vial of blue-green solvent wrapped in caution tape, with dark tar drops sliding off a bent metal scraper; saturated neon chemistry, sharp readable item pose, Bird Squad title splash mood.

supplies.name: Feather Splint
supplies.description: Heal 4 Cohesion and reduce each flock debuff by 1.
supplies.visualBrief: A soft feather splint kit: two tiny carbon slats, cloth wrap, and a mint-green balm tin, arranged like a field medic roll; warm compassionate palette, crisp bird-scale utility, title-splash urban fantasy realism.

supplies.name: Mirror Shard
supplies.description: Draw 2, then discard 1.
supplies.visualBrief: A triangular shard of mirror taped into a bottlecap frame, reflecting pink and cyan rooftop signs at sharp angles; sleek tactical shine, high contrast, streetwear accessory feel, Bird Squad title splash style.

supplies.name: Emergency Call
supplies.description: Gain 1 Wingbeat. Draw 1.
supplies.visualBrief: A tiny whistle-and-radio charm made from a cracked earbud shell and copper wire, vibrating with a gold signal ring; heroic compact silhouette, neon highlights, practical courier gear from the title splash world.

supplies.name: Shade Cloth
supplies.description: Gain 2 Open Sky Guard. If used on route, it applies to the next fight.
supplies.visualBrief: A folded rectangle of dark teal shade cloth with stitched orange edge marks and two bent safety pins, catching a cool shadow against hot rooftop light; grounded textile detail, bold splash-art contrast.

supplies.name: Rooftop Decoy
supplies.description: Gain 6 Cover and 1 Open Sky Guard.
supplies.visualBrief: A flat decoy bird silhouette cut from black plastic signage, mounted on a bright blue wire stand with reflective tape eyes; clever rooftop trick, punchy graphic profile, Bird Squad title-splash lighting.

supplies.name: Molt Pin
supplies.description: Enter Molt and gain 1 Open Sky Guard.
supplies.visualBrief: An enamel lapel pin shaped like a half-shed feather, violet enamel cracked to reveal gold underneath, clasped to a tiny harness strap; stylish flock identity object, title-splash streetwear finish.

supplies.name: Wire Snips
supplies.description: Remove up to 8 enemy Cover and apply 2 Winded.
supplies.visualBrief: Miniature red-handled wire snips with a fresh-cut cable curling away, tiny sparks frozen in the jaws; aggressive utility pose, sharp silhouette, neon rooftop hardware in Bird Squad splash-art style.

supplies.name: Spare Harness
supplies.description: Gain 14 Cover.
supplies.visualBrief: A folded bird-scale safety harness with patched navy straps, brass buckles, and one yellow rescue tag; sturdy protective silhouette, premium urban expedition gear, dramatic title-splash rim light.

supplies.name: Signal Kite
supplies.description: Draw 1, gain 2 Open Sky Guard, gain 1 Resonance, and draw 1 extra next turn.
supplies.visualBrief: A folded micro-kite made from translucent orange plastic and black thread, painted with a cyan route glyph, fluttering above a rooftop antenna hook; elegant signal object, luminous title-splash palette.

supplies.name: Storm Lantern
supplies.description: Gain 2 Wingbeat and draw 2. Lose 4 Cohesion.
supplies.visualBrief: A tiny storm lantern built from a lighter cap and violet glass bead, blazing gold in wind with loose wires whipping around it; dangerous high-energy artifact, cinematic Bird Squad title-splash glow.

supplies.name: Cache Key
supplies.description: Draw 1 and gain 8 Cover. If you opened a Cache this district, draw +1.
supplies.visualBrief: A strange brass vending-machine key tied to a red courier thread, with a scratched rooftop cache symbol on the bow; mysterious found-object charm, crisp silhouette, title-splash urban treasure mood.

supplies.name: Rain Cape
supplies.description: Gain 3 Open Sky Guard and heal 8 Cohesion.
supplies.visualBrief: A glossy midnight-blue rain cape folded around a tiny hood, with reflective silver wing stripes and warm city lights beading on the surface; protective, stylish, and heroic in Bird Squad title-splash style.

supplies.name: Return Ticket
supplies.description: Return 1 non-Molt card from discard to hand, then draw 1.
supplies.visualBrief: A folded transit ticket with a punched wing symbol, red courier thread, and a tiny brass clip; a crisp bird-scale route charm with neon platform reflections and title-splash street grit.

supplies.name: Nest Clamp
supplies.description: Gain 4 Cover. The next Nest Cover card gains +8 Cover.
supplies.visualBrief: A compact spring clamp wrapped in green tape, biting into two little scaffold slats with orange safety paint; sturdy urban repair gear, readable silhouette, Bird Squad title-screen lighting.

supplies.name: Smoke Thread
supplies.description: Apply 3 Winded to the selected enemy. Draw 1 extra next turn.
supplies.visualBrief: A spool of black thread leaking violet smoke, with a cyan bead counterweight and taped needle tucked through it; tactical misdirection object, high-contrast neon rooftop style.

supplies.name: Windcatcher Spool
supplies.description: Draw 1. Gain +2 Wingbeat next turn.
supplies.visualBrief: A tiny kite-string spool with translucent orange fins and a blue wind gauge, thread pulled taut as if catching rooftop gusts; sleek route gear with Bird Squad splash-art glow.

supplies.name: Resonance Battery
supplies.description: Gain 2 Resonance, then spend all Resonance to deal 3 damage per Resonance to the selected enemy.
supplies.visualBrief: A cracked teal battery cell wired into a bottlecap casing, pulsing with gold-blue resonance arcs; dangerous pocket power source, dramatic neon highlights, title-splash rooftop hardware.

supplies.name: Oath Ledger
supplies.description: Gain 20 Scrap and draw 1. Lose 3 Cohesion.
supplies.visualBrief: A weatherproof mini ledger strapped shut with red cord, brass tally charms hanging from the spine and one page glowing with market ink; stylish risky bargain object, Bird Squad title-splash mood.

supplies.name: Map Sticker Strip
supplies.description: Preview the next reachable route choices and gain 5 Scrap.
supplies.visualBrief: A strip of tiny neon route stickers half peeled from wax paper, with arrows, rooftop marks, and one red thread tab; crisp bird-scale planning gear in the Bird Squad title-splash salvage style.

supplies.name: Thermos Lid
supplies.description: Heal 5 Cohesion. On route, gain 1 Open Sky Guard for the next fight; in combat, gain it now.
supplies.visualBrief: A dented teal thermos cap filled with warm seed broth, steam curling around a tiny spoon and safety-pin handle; cozy rooftop field snack with title-splash neon rim light.

supplies.name: Bus Token Cache
supplies.description: Gain 12 Scrap, preview the next route choice, and pack a random Supply if there is room.
supplies.visualBrief: Three brass transit tokens tied in a red cord bundle, one stamped with a wing, glowing with city-platform reflections; compact route-economy charm in Bird Squad title art style.

supplies.name: Chalk Dust Pouch
supplies.description: Remove up to 6 enemy Cover. Draw 1.
supplies.visualBrief: A small black pouch spilling pale blue chalk dust, clipped to a climbing buckle and scratched roof tile; tactical anti-Cover tool with bright rooftop grit.

supplies.name: Market IOU
supplies.description: Next district starts with 1 free Preen and 10 Scrap. Lose 2 Cohesion.
supplies.visualBrief: A waterproof IOU slip folded around a brass tally charm, red string seal, and oily market ink; risky favor token with Bird Squad title-splash lighting.

supplies.name: Sky Sugar
supplies.description: Gain 1 Wingbeat. Draw 1. Draw 1 extra next turn.
supplies.visualBrief: A cracked candy tin of bright amber sugar crystals with a tiny feather scoop and electric-blue wrapper scraps; fast combo snack with neon rooftop highlights.

supplies.name: Anchor Threader
supplies.description: Gain 6 Cover. Retain 1 card. The next Nest Cover card gains +3 Cover.
supplies.visualBrief: A curved needle threaded with black anchor cord, wrapped around a green-taped micro spool and brass washer; sturdy setup tool in Bird Squad title-screen salvage style.

supplies.name: Spare Pocket
supplies.description: Increase Supply capacity by 1 for this run and pack a random Supply if there is room.
supplies.visualBrief: A stitched navy harness pocket with orange zipper teeth, clipped-on bottlecap tag, and bright fabric patches; premium supply-build gear with crisp standalone silhouette.
